theme.description: Immersive, cinematic dark mode. Inspired by Lando Norris' awwwards-winning site but tailored to Lewis Hamilton's legendary status. Think carbon fiber textures, stadium lights at dusk, depth-driven layouts, and vibrant high-performance accents.

headings.family: Unbounded, Cabinet Grotesk, or Clash Display
headings.usage: Use for massive, screen-spanning hero text and section titles. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for stats descriptions, quotes, and readable paragraphs.

labels.usage: Use for stats labels, years, track names, and overlines.

layouts.global: Immersive one-page scroll. Use Lenis for momentum scrolling. High contrast. Section transitions should feel like cinematic cuts.
layouts.hero: Cinematic hero with a large helmet or driver image, deep parallax, massive typography cutting behind/in front of the subject. Use optical alignment and avoid generic centering.
layouts.timeline: Scroll-linked vertical or horizontal timeline showcasing championship years. Heavy use of staggered entrance animations.
layouts.stats_bento: Bento grid for dominant cars, best tracks, wins, podiums. Tight gaps (gap-4) but internal padding p-8. 1px borders with subtle glow.
layouts.quotes_section: Massive editorial typography. Slow marquee for background text, overlapping with static profound quotes.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) and high saturation. Never use fully transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or overlays over content. Add a 1px delicate inner stroke for premium feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle 1px borders (border-white/10). Use the tracing beam effect for high-conversion stats cards.
visual_enhancers.backgrounds: Grain/noise overlays mandatory to eliminate digital flatness. No flat full-screen gradients.

patterns: Parallax scroll on background images to simulate depth.
Hover effects on cards: slight lift (-translate-y-2), shadow-2xl, border brightening.
Micro-animations for all interactive elements (hover, focus, click states).

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion 3D or GSAP/ScrollTrigger equivalents for 2.5D depth. Rely on layering high-res images with z-index manipulation (parallax and scaling) rather than heavy WebGL unless specifically optimizing for performance.
3d_libraries.instructions: Foreground subject scales up on scroll, background scales down.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use heavy gradient overlays (bg-black/50) or text-shadow when placing text over images.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap massive animations in a prefers-reduced-motion check if possible.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements and informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end, cinematic fan site for Lewis Hamilton.
Use JavaScript (.js or .jsx). Do not use TypeScript.
Do NOT use standard template layouts. Ensure heavy use of negative space, asymmetric layouts, and overlapping elements.
Integrate smooth momentum scrolling using Lenis.
Use Framer Motion to animate text, images, and layout blocks dynamically as they enter the viewport.
The design must be fully responsive, scaling gracefully from mobile to massive desktop displays.
Use the provided Unsplash and Pexels image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image services.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.

Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx
